text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score of the probabilistic forecast, in points of the substation's capacity (smaller is better), by how many days ahead the forecast is. The chain is an ERA5-trained stage 1 model plus a stage 2 calibrator; its lag anomalies use ERA5T, CAMS, and the ENS control member's early leads, with a 7-hour telemetry delay. N1 is an XGBoost quantile model trained on the ENS control member. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds.'
text.tspan: Quantile score of the probabilistic forecast, in points of the substation's capacity
(smaller is better), by how many days ahead the forecast is.
The chain is an ERA5-trained stage 1 model plus a stage 2 calibrator; its lag anomalies use
ERA5T, CAMS, and the ENS control member's early leads, with a 7-hour telemetry delay. N1 is
an XGBoost quantile model trained on the ENS control member.
16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds.
